ei.lesson: 어법 — TV 속 친밀도와 감정 강도 조절

fullPassage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and (A)[familiarity / closeness] are important in making the (B)[fictional / factual] environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to (C)[reduce / increase] emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: familiarity(친숙함) — fictional(허구의) — reduce(줄이다)
det.analysis:
① closeness — fictional — reduce: (A) closeness는 본문에 등장하지만 해당 위치는 familiarity가 원문 ←오답
② familiarity — fictional — reduce: 세 단어 모두 원문 그대로 ←정답
③ familiarity — factual — reduce: (B) factual(사실의)은 fictional(허구의)의 반의어
④ familiarity — fictional — increase: (C) increase(증가시키다)는 reduce(줄이다)의 반의어
det.tip: familiarity(친숙함), fictional(허구의), reduce(줄이다) — 모두 원문 표현. closeness도 본문에 나오지만 (A) 위치의 원문은 familiarity.

det.korean: perceive(인식하다) — involving(포함하는) — removed(제거된, 벗어난)
det.analysis:

② ignore — involving — removed: (A) ignore(무시하다)는 perceive(인식하다)의 반의어
③ perceive — excluding — removed: (B) excluding(배제하는)은 involving(포함하는)의 반의어

det.tip: perceive(인식하다), involving(관련된/포함하는), removed(제거된) — 모두 원문 표현.

det.analysis:

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite ①<u>important</u> in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more ②<u>real</u>. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to ③<u>amplify</u> emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely ④<u>distanced</u> from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①important(중요한) ②real(실제의) ③amplify(증폭시키다→원문: reduce 줄이다) ④distanced(거리를 둔)
det.analysis:
① important: 친밀감이 감정 강도 관리에 중요하다 — 문맥상 적절
② real: 허구의 환경을 더 실제처럼 만든다 — 문맥상 적절
③ amplify: 증폭시키다 → 원문은 reduce(줄이다). 폭력 장면에서 친밀감 변수가 감정 강도를 증폭시킨다고 하면 문맥과 반대 ←정답
④ distanced: 우리 것과 안전하게 거리를 둔 배경 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: reduce emotional intensity(감정 강도를 줄이다). amplify(증폭시키다)로 바꾸면 글의 논지와 정반대.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of ①<u>detachment</u> are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are ②<u>familiar</u>. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the ③<u>imaginary</u> story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for ④<u>solutions</u> to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①detachment(초연함→원문: closeness 친밀감) ②familiar(친숙한) ③imaginary(가상의) ④solutions(해결책)
det.analysis:
① detachment: 초연함 → 원문은 closeness(친밀감). 친밀감의 정도 변화가 중요하다는 글의 핵심 논지와 반대 ←정답
② familiar: 우리가 친숙한 유형 — 문맥상 적절
③ imaginary: 가상의 이야기를 실제처럼 인식 — 문맥상 적절
④ solutions: 문제의 해결책을 찾는다 — 문맥상 적절
det.tip: Changes in the degree of closeness(친밀감의 정도 변화). detachment(초연함/거리감)로 바꾸면 글 전체 논지 붕괴.

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions ①<u>induced</u> by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it ②<u>easier</u> for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place social problems involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those ③<u>fictionalized</u> characters search for solutions to our problems in settings ④<u>dangerously</u> distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①induced(유발된) ②easier(더 쉬운) ③fictionalized(허구화된) ④dangerously(위험하게→원문: safely 안전하게)
det.analysis:
① induced: TV에 의해 유발된 감정 — 문맥상 적절
② easier: 친숙함이 인식을 더 쉽게 만든다 — 문맥상 적절
③ fictionalized: 허구화된 캐릭터 — 문맥상 적절
④ dangerously: 위험하게 → 원문은 safely(안전하게). 우리 것과 안전하게 거리를 둔 배경이라는 맥락에서 위험하게는 반대 ←정답
det.tip: settings safely distanced from our own(우리와 안전하게 거리를 둔 배경). dangerously(위험하게)로 바꾸면 거리를 두는 것이 안전이 아닌 위험이라는 모순.

③ altered: 변경된 — 다른 의미 축

det.tip: distanced(거리를 둔) ↔ adjacent(인접한). 본문의 safely distanced from our own은 우리와 안전하게 거리를 둔 배경.

questions.passage:
(A) Most TV shows are <u>set</u> in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers.

(B) She bought a complete <u>set</u> of kitchen knives as a housewarming gift.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 set가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) are set in the present = 현재에 설정되어 있다 / (B) a complete set = 완전한 세트(한 벌)
det.analysis:
① (A) 세트 — (B) 설정하다: (A)에서 TV 쇼가 '세트'에 있다는 해석은 부적절
② (A) 놓다 — (B) 규정: 두 문맥 모두 부정확
③ (A) 설정하다 — (B) 세트: (A) be set in = ~에 설정되다/배경이 되다, (B) a set of = 한 세트의 ←정답
④ (A) 고정하다 — (B) 놓다: 두 문맥 모두 부정확
det.tip: set 다의어: (A) be set in the present(현재를 배경으로 하다) — 수동태로 '설정되다', (B) a set of knives(칼 한 세트) — 명사로 '세트/한 벌'.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a factor or element that is liable to change or that can be changed"

det.korean: 변할 수 있거나 변경될 수 있는 요인 또는 요소
det.analysis:
① constant: 상수, 불변의 것 — variable의 반의어
② principle: 원칙, 원리 — 다른 의미
③ variable: 변수, 변할 수 있는 요소 — 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
④ sequence: 순서, 연속 — 다른 의미
det.tip: variable은 본문에서 the closeness variable(친밀감 변수)로 사용되었다. '변할 수 있는 요인/요소'라는 뜻.

questions.passage: Closeness and familiarity are important in making the __________ environment more real. (fiction)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: fiction(명사: 허구, 소설) → fictional(형용사: 허구의)
det.analysis: the __________(fiction) environment — 명사 environment를 수식하는 형용사가 필요. fiction(명사)을 형용사형 fictional로 변환.
det.tip: the fictional environment — 허구의 환경. fiction → fictional(형용사).

questions.passage: Television entertainment tends to place social problems __________ violence in another time and place. (involve)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: involve(동사: 포함하다, 수반하다) → involving(현재분사: ~을 수반하는)
det.analysis: social problems __________(involve) violence — 명사 social problems를 뒤에서 수식하는 현재분사가 필요. involve(동사)를 현재분사 involving으로 변환하여 '폭력을 수반하는 사회 문제'라는 의미.
det.tip: social problems involving violence — 폭력을 수반하는 사회 문제. involve → involving(현재분사/분사구문).

questions.passage: Changes in the degree of closeness are quite important in managing emotional intensity. Take, for example, emotions induced by television. Closeness and familiarity are important in making the fictional environment more real. Accordingly, most TV shows are set in the present or in a time within the memory of the viewers. Most characters are supposed to be types with whom we are familiar. Such closeness and familiarity make it easier for us to perceive the imaginary story to be a real one. In other circumstances, such as when violence is shown on TV, the closeness variable is used to reduce emotional intensity. Television entertainment tends to place __________ involving violence in another time and place, letting us watch those fictionalized characters search for solutions to our problems in settings safely distanced from our own. When violence occurs in a contemporary setting, it is generally the product of the interaction of police and criminals — again, it is removed from the lives of good citizenry.

② personal memories: 개인 기억 — 폭력과의 연결이 문맥과 무관
③ scientific theories: 과학 이론 — 문맥과 무관
④ economic policies: 경제 정책 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: place social problems involving violence in another time and place — 폭력을 수반하는 사회 문제를 다른 시공간에 배치.

det.korean: 동시대적 배경에서 폭력이 발생할 때, 그것은 대체로 ___의 산물이다.
det.analysis:
① the imagination of writers: 작가의 상상력 — 본문에 언급 없음
② the interaction of police and criminals: 경찰과 범죄자의 상호작용 — 원문과 정확히 일치 ←정답
③ the influence of social media: 소셜 미디어의 영향 — 본문에 언급 없음
④ the entertainment of audiences: 관객의 오락 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: the product of the interaction of police and criminals — 경찰과 범죄자의 상호작용의 산물. 동시대 배경의 폭력은 경찰-범죄자 상호작용으로 한정된다는 뜻.
